summary: Verified new .env.example templates and ran full regression across backend + frontend. Both /app/frontend/.env.example (contains REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) and /app/backend/.env.example (contains MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, CORS_ORIGINS, RESEND_API_KEY, SENDER_EMAIL, SALES_EMAIL) exist with correct content and Windows/Mac copy-and-rename instructions. All 20 backend pytest tests pass (health email_configured=false, /api/contact valid+invalid, /api/roi-estimate valid+invalid+list, /api/insights >=6 seeded posts each with image_url, insights POST valid+3 invalid, /og-cover.png). Frontend homepage on the preview URL renders all expected sections (ClientsStrip, About, Services, TechStack via #tech-stack, CaseStudies, RoiCalculator via #roi-calculator, Industries, Insights, Contact). Insights section shows 5 initial cards + working Load More button (data-testid=insights-load-more) — clicking it took count 5 -> 8 and the label updated from 'Load 3 more notes 5/10' to 'Load 2 more notes 8/10'. Contact form submission with valid payload shows the success toast 'Thanks — we'll be in touch within 1 business day.' with no CORS/API errors in the console.

issues: React console warning: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute.' Some element is rendered with src="" instead of null/omitted. Harmless but noisy — likely a fallback/placeholder image in one of the components (Insights image onError handler or a logo). Should render nothing or a valid placeholder src when the URL is empty.

action_items: (Low) Trace the source of the empty-string warning and either omit the src attribute or supply a placeholder to eliminate the console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: .env.example files are well documented with copy-and-rename instructions and enumerate the accepted REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL values (local Java 8080, local FastAPI 8001, Render prod). Good developer onboarding.

Frontend Insights component now supports Load More (initial 5, step 3) and correctly shows a 'you're all caught up' message once exhausted — resolves the prior 6-card hard cap concern raised in iteration_4.
Contact form inputs already have data-testid attributes (contact-input-name/email/phone/company/message) — good for automated testing.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds >=6 insight posts on startup; no additional seed data created by this iteration. All TEST_ prefixed submissions during testing are harmless demo records.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_5 was a documentation/regression pass for the added .env.example templates. All 20 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/ pass. Frontend Insights Load More flow is verified (5 -> 8 -> label 'Load 2 more notes 8/10'). Contact submit works end-to-end with success toast. Only lingering item is a low-priority React warning about an .
